title: Host facts reported at enrollment and in every heartbeat

agent_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the running agent binary (compared with the build the control plane ships)

reboot_required.description: The distribution asked for a reboot (/var/run/reboot-required: kernel or libc updates)

tls_certificates.description: Certificates the edge obtained over ACME (its storage under /var/lib/caddy), the latest expiry per name. Renewals start 30 days before expiry, so one closer than that means renewal is failing. Omitted when there are none

local_edge.description: This is the control-plane machine (falak-ctl wrote /etc/falak/local-edge.env): the server's edge listens behind the control plane's edge on a bridge address (internal ports, PROXY protocol) and docker workloads run under the capped workload slice. Omitted = false

features.description: Protocol additions the agent understands (e.g. edge.access_log, telemetry.log_kind, system.upgrade_agent.v2). Agents reject unknown payload fields, so the control plane sends optional fields only to agents that list the feature. Absent = none

ebpf.description: The eBPF probe (docs/plans/network/ebpf.md, feature net.ebpf): whether this kernel can run it, the setting as the agent applied it, and what runs

reason.description: why the kernel cannot run it

detail.description: the load error, the program groups not attached, or the overhead that tripped the budget

overhead_percent.description: the probe's CPU over the last 5 minutes, percent of the machine's capacity (all CPUs)
